method: Actual current handler versus a 7.52 cached-handler code replay, including its early guard, in the same owned window and shared current backend. Seven alternating trials of eight calls per workload. Initial four-workload run retained; final fixture also checks a 2047-unit valid Unicode description. No timing pass threshold; not an older executable or IDM comparison.
interpretation: Ordinary-workload differences are small and trial ranges overlap; direction varies by workload/run. The final unfiltered filename median is about 0.11 ms higher, while other cases are slightly higher or lower. The Unicode median differs by about 0.01 ms. No uniform or statistically resolved speed benefit is claimed. Source inspection establishes removal of the redundant normalization/allocation on canonical hot hits, not a measured whole-handler allocation count.
